call_points.text: Tax rate expected to normalise at around 25% for coming quarters after the deferred-tax reversal.
Peptide manufacturing capacity with end-to-end solid-phase synthesis to complete commissioning by end of FY27.
Three NCE CDMO programs in advanced phases to commercialise in FY28.
More than 25 NCE programs in API division, with 3 in late stage.
Aflibercept on track for India launch in FY27, partnered with three Indian companies.
Nivolumab India clinical study started; launch targeted for FY28.
Regulatory pathway is the main risk that could slow growth, the CFO said.
Unicycive partner received a CRL from USFDA and plans to refile in Q3.
Management declined providing top-line or bottom-line numerical guidance for FY27, citing ongoing business ramp-up.
A 35% EBITDA margin is an ambitious target and will not be achieved immediately due to reinvestment.
Albumin European IMPD submission is planned in H1FY27 following completion of batches at the new facility.
Management does not project meaningful financial contribution from partner Unicycive's OLC program in FY27.
Rotigotine transdermal patch is slated for launch in Europe in FY27, with volume ramp-up expected in FY28.
API CDMO revenue reached approximately ₹110 Cr in FY26, with a similar run-rate achieved in biologics CDMO.
Jadcherla facility is awaiting USFDA re-audit, but US supplies are maintained through third-party CMO partners.
**Record quarterly revenue:** Q4FY26 revenue reached a record ₹439 Cr, up 30% YoY driven by FDF and Biologics.
**NorUDCA commercial scale:** First-in-class launch in India gained strong traction, providing healthy order book visibility.
**Transdermal patch pipeline:** First EU patch launch expected in coming quarters; first USFDA patch submission completed in Q4FY26.
**OLC CDMO program:** Partner Unicycive resubmitted NDA with a PDUFA action date of June 29, 2026.
**Recombinant Human Albumin:** Initiating Phase 3 clinical trials in India and Europe in 1HFY27.

timeline.summary: Shilpa Medicare published its FY26 earnings presentation reporting record revenue of ₹1,549 Cr and EBITDA of ₹445 Cr.
Shilpa Medicare Limited’s **Ritu Tiwary** uploaded Q4-FY26 earnings call recording on 22 May 2026 via [website link](https://vbshilpa.com/investor-presentation.php).
Shilpa Medicare held its Q4FY26 earnings call, guiding for sustained capex, steady API/formulation expansion, and no formal FY27 numbers.
USFDA completed Pre-Approval Inspection at Unit VI (Bengaluru) with 5 procedural Form 483 observations.
Shilpa Biocare announced a strategic equity partnership to acquire a 30.4% stake in Spain's Gate2Brain for Euro 7 million.

On 10 August 2026, Shilpa Medicare filed the transcript of its Q1FY27 call, where management reported revenue of ₹469 Cr (+43% YoY) and PAT of ₹101 Cr (+115% YoY), helped by a deferred-tax reversal, and guided to a ~25% tax rate ahead.
